title: Romantic Getaway to Bali: A Couple's Guide for 2026
metaDescription: Plan the perfect romantic trip to Bali. Sunset spots, intimate dining, and unforgettable experiences for couples in love.
excerpt: Bali sets the stage for romance like nowhere else. From sunset views to intimate dinners, this guide will help you plan the perfect couple's getaway.
author: Travel Editors
content:
There is something about Bali that captures the imagination of travelers worldwide. For those planning a romantic getaway to Bali, this guide will show you the best of what awaits.

## Most Romantic Spots

- Sunset viewpoints that offer breathtaking panoramas over Bali
- Secluded beaches and hidden coves perfect for private moments
- Candlelit restaurants serving the finest local cuisine
- Scenic walks through charming neighborhoods and historic streets

![Romantic Bali](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1537996194471-e657df975ab4?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Romantic Activities

Cooking classes for two let you learn the secrets of Indonesia's cuisine while bonding over delicious food.

## Where to Stay

Villa rentals offer privacy and space for couples who want to create their own romantic retreat in Bali.
